description: #310: only postgres and caddy, pinned by full tag and digest in infra/docker-compose.yml and in the services of .github/workflows/ci.yml (Dependabot does not read workflow services images, dependabot-core#5541). #430: and the rust and debian base images of apps/api/Dockerfile and apps/web/Dockerfile, pinned by digest. Every other dependency stays out of scope here.

packageRules.description: Off by default: actions, MinIO mirror images and anything else these managers find.
postgres and caddy: one PR per new minor/patch or digest republication, all files at once (image-pins.ts requires one pin everywhere).

#430: the Dockerfile base images. Their tags are floating on purpose (rust:1-slim-bookworm follows the stable toolchain, as ci.yml does; debian:bookworm-slim follows Debian's point and security releases), so what moves is the digest: one PR per republication, both Dockerfiles at once.

No major series change: rust 1 -> 2 stays a reviewed change, not a bot PR. debian:bookworm-slim names no version Renovate compares, so only its digest moves; leaving bookworm is a reviewed change too.
No major series change: postgres 16 -> 17 needs a dump/restore, caddy 2 -> 3 a reading of the Caddyfile.
